D5/S3/Constants/PentagonCosines.pentagon.name: D5.S3.Constants.PentagonCosines.pentagon_golden_cosines
D5/S3/Constants/PentagonCosines.pentagon.signature: theorem pentagon_golden_cosines : 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 5) = Real.goldenRatio ∧ 2 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 5) = Real.goldenRatio⁻¹ ∧ 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 5) + 2 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 5) = Real.sqrt 5 ∧ Irrational (2 * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi / 5))
